fibre_encoding: literal_fibres[i] lists every colouring on increasing interior_vertices for fixed literal boundary rows[i]; empty list is empty fibre, empty string is the unique no-interior assignment

negative_controls.name: repeated_boundary_vertex
negative_controls.reason: boundary is not a simple ordered C5

operations.P: retain all old vertices and edges; add fresh x adjacent b4,b0,b1; replace boundary by (x,b1,b2,b3,b4); add oriented faces (b1,b0,x),(b0,b4,x)
operations.R: retain graph and cells; replace boundary by (b4,b0,b1,b2,b3)
